data.one_liner: SIMD-based linear algebra and statistics library for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides high-performance vector and matrix operations implemented using SIMD types (Float32x4 and Float64x2) for data science and numeric calculations. It includes linear algebra operations, decompositions, distances, statistical methods, and system of linear equations solving.
use_when: You need performant vector and matrix math leveraging SIMD in Dart.
You are building data science or machine learning tools in Dart and need fast numeric data manipulation.
avoid_when: You only need basic 3D/4D vector math for graphics (use vector_math instead).
Your application does not require heavy numeric calculations or linear algebra.
strengths: High performance through SIMD optimization (Float32x4 and Float64x2).
Immutable vector and matrix implementations with rich mathematical operations.
weaknesses: Limited to linear algebra and data science use cases.
More complex than standard List operations if only simple arithmetic is needed.
